title: job.resume
description: Run the paused job again. The file it paused in restarts from its checkpoints; files it finished are not run again. job.bad_state for a job that is not paused. A restored job (job.list: restored) joins the queue behind the waiting ones and continues from the file it had reached; when the queue was idle it is checked and takes the run lock as a new job does, so it is refused as job.submit is (config.invalid, job.unsafe_setting, job.nothing_to_render, run.locked, engine.stopping).
